recent_articles.title: Rajya Sabha defections, constitutional questions - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Seven **Aam Aadmi Party** (AAP) MPs announced on April 24, 2026, that over two-thirds of their party's members had merged with the **Bharatiya Janata Party** (BJP), invoking the 10th Schedule of the Constitution. This move has drawn attention to constitutional questions regarding the interpretation of anti-defection laws and the scope of the "merger" exception.  This event, occurring at the national level in the Rajya Sabha, carries significant political consequences.

recent_articles.title: Court allows police interrogation of Shiv Sena MLA Sanjay Gaikwad over threat to publisher - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Kolhapur** court has granted permission for police to question Shiv Sena MLA Sanjay Gaikwad in connection with threats made against publisher Prashant Ambi regarding the book "Who was Shivaji?".  Gaikwad, who had previously objected to the use of the word "Shivaji" in the book and threatened Ambi, now regrets his abusive language but maintains he will continue to oppose books critical of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj. The incident dates back to 1988 when the book was published, and Mr. Ambi has received threatening calls since then.  The case is expected to proceed with a notice issued by the Rajarampuri police station directing Gaikwad to appear for questioning or submit a written response.

recent_articles.title: 12 MPs, four Parliamentary panels selected for Sansad Ratna Awards - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The Prime Point Foundation** has selected **12 MPs** and four Parliamentary Committees for this year's Sansad Ratna Awards.  **Jagdambika Pal**, **P.P. Chaudhary**, **Nishikant Dubey**, and **Shrikant Eknath Shinde** are among the individuals recognized, while the **Committee on Agriculture**, **Finance Committee**, **Rural Development and Panchayati Raj Committee**, and **Coal and Mines Committee** have also been awarded for their performance.

recent_articles.title: Tell your ‘petty politicians’ not to blame the court for delay, CJI tells Thackeray-Shinde factions - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Supreme Court** expressed frustration with the "petty politicians" of the Uddhav Thackeray and Eknath Shinde factions of the Shiv Sena for making accusations against the court regarding delays in their dispute over the party symbol.  Chief Justice of India Surya Kant criticized the parties' media statements, urging them to refrain from such actions. Senior advocate Mukul Rohatgi, representing the Shinde faction, acknowledged that irresponsible comments were made and urged the court to set a specific date for final arguments. The case, which has been pending for years, centers on the Election Commission's February 2023 order assigning the symbol 'bow and arrow' to the Shinde faction, challenging the Thackeray faction's claim to the party name and symbol.

recent_articles.title: Ten new MLCs sworn in at Maharashtra Vidhan Bhavan - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Ten newly elected members of the Maharashtra Legislative Council (MLC)** took their oaths on Thursday, May 14, 2026, following the end of nine sitting MLCs' terms. The new members include representatives from the **BJP**, **Shiv Sena**, and **NCP**.  The ceremony was presided over by **Legislative Council chairperson Ram Shinde** and attended by key figures like **Assembly Speaker Rahul Narwekar**, **Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis**, and **Deputy Chief Ministers Eknath Shinde and Sunetra Ajit**. The Upper House currently has 22 vacancies, with the majority of seats held by the **BJP** due to their dominance in the Legislative Assembly.

recent_articles.title: ​Split wide open: On the AIADMK, Tamil Nadu politics - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **AIADMK**, the principal opposition party in Tamil Nadu, is facing a split after a second consecutive election defeat.  **C. Joseph Vijay**, the Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu, has indicated his support for the dissident group led by former Ministers **C.Ve. Shanmugam** and **S.P. Velumani**. The dissidents have announced their intention to support the Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK) government.  The Palaniswami camp claims that all 47 legislators gave written consent for **Edappadi K. Palaniswami** as the AIADMK legislature party leader, citing a Supreme Court verdict in the Shiv Sena case. The Assembly Speaker will need to assess the merits of both groups' claims and may soon have to draw on his experience and legal advice.

recent_articles.title: What does the BJP’s victory in West Bengal mean for India’s democracy? | Elections | Al Jazeera
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)** has won the West Bengal state assembly elections, marking a significant shift in Indian politics.  Critics argue that controversial electoral roll changes played a role in the BJP's landslide victory, raising concerns about the future of democracy and its impact on India's Muslim population. The outcome could reshape national politics for 200 million Muslims.

recent_articles.title: ‘Defeated by conspiracy’: West Bengal chief minister refuses to resign after election loss | India | The Guardian
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Mamata Banerjee**, India's most powerful female politician, has refused to resign as chief minister of West Bengal despite the **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)** winning a landslide victory in state elections.  Banerjee claims the election was "looted" by conspiracy and that she will not step down. The governor of West Bengal has threatened to send police if Banerjee does not voluntarily relinquish her position, potentially leading to legal challenges. The BJP has responded with accusations of "constitutional blasphemy" and a ban on advisors appointed by Banerjee from entering their offices.  Banerjee's refusal to step down could lead to further political turmoil in the state.

recent_articles.title: Maharashtra Legislative Council elections to be unopposed as Congress backtracks, Shinde fields two candidates - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Congress** has withdrawn its decision to field a candidate for the nine Legislative Council seats in Maharashtra, supporting **Ambadas Danve** from **Shiv Sena UBT** after marathon meetings and phone calls between top leaders.  The decision was announced by **Maharashtra Congress president Harshawardhan Sapkal**, who also spoke alongside leaders of the Maha Vikas Aghadi. After a day of speculation, nine candidates filed their nominations for the seats, with each party securing its allotted quota.

recent_articles.title: Fadnavis backs ex-CJI amid row over meeting with Dhirendra Shastri - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Devendra Fadnavis**, **Maharashtra Chief Minister**,  came out in support of former Chief Justice of India (CJI) B.R. Gavai after social activist Shyam Manav criticized his meeting with Dhirendra Shastri, chief priest of the Bageshwar Dham.  Manav argued that Gavai should not claim the legacy of Dr. B.R. Ambedkar and challenged Shastri to accept an anti-superstition panel's challenge. Senior Congress leader Vijay Wadettiwar accused political leaders of elevating babas (religious figures) in Maharashtra, criticizing Gavai for meeting Shastri.  The controversy comes after a similar incident involving Shastri's claims about Shivaji Maharaj.

recent_articles.title: No secret meeting took place with Uddhav Thackeray, says Devendra Fadnavis - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Devendra Fadnavis**, the **Maharashtra** Chief Minister, denied meeting **Uddhav Thackeray** despite reports of a secret meeting.  He stated that false news is being spread and action will be taken against those spreading it.  Fadnavis also addressed comments made by Dheerendra Shastri regarding historical meetings between Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj and Samarth Ramdas, stating there's no historical evidence to support such claims. He emphasized the importance of responsible reactions and avoiding unnecessary controversy.

recent_articles.title: Face-off between MNS and Shiv Sena leader Nirupam over mandatory Marathi for autorickshaw and taxi drivers - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A protest erupted in Mumbai on Friday over a new mandatory Marathi language proficiency requirement for licensed autorickshaw and taxi drivers in Maharashtra, effective May 1st.  **Maharashtra Navnirman Sena (MNS)** party functionaries clashed with **Shiv Sena leader Sanjay Nirupam**, who had appealed to the state government to reconsider the move. The protest escalated with MNS party members allegedly throwing stones at Mr. Nirupam's car.

recent_articles.title: BJP to contest four seats in upcoming Maharashtra Legislative Council polls - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **BJP** will contest four of the nine seats in the upcoming Maharashtra Legislative Council biennial elections, scheduled for May 12. The party's strategy was discussed at a meeting led by Chief Minister **Devendra Fadnavis**.  Candidates for the by-election for the seat vacated by Pradnya Satav are being shortlisted and will be sent to the central leadership for approval.  The Election Commission of India has set a quota of 29 votes for each council seat, with the by-election requiring 144 votes.

recent_articles.title: Baramati, Rahuri all set to conduct byelections on April 23 - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Maharashtra** is holding by-elections in two constituencies, Baramati and Rahuri, on April 23, 2026.  The **Congress** withdrew its candidate from Baramati, paving the way for Deputy Chief Minister Sunetra Pawar to contest. The Baramati by-election is significant as it marks the first election since the death of the former MLA, Ajit Pawar. In Rahuri, the BJP's Akshay Kardile faces off against NCP-SP candidate Govind Mokate from the **Maha Vikas Aghadi**.

recent_articles.title: Mahayuti to launch signature campaign in Maharashtra on Women’s Reservation Bill - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The ruling Mahayuti** party in Maharashtra is launching a signature campaign from April 21 to collect one crore signatures of women, protesting the recent defeat of the Women’s Reservation Bill and Delimitation Bill. **Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis** challenged the opposition parties for an open debate on the issue, accusing them of stalling increased women's reservation and SC/ST reservations.  **Supriya Sule**, an NCP SP MP, and **Praniti Shinde**, a Congress MP, accepted the challenge, while **Rahul Gandhi**, the Congress leader, was accused by Fadnavis of being a liar. The opposition parties countered that the government is trying to use the issue for political gain ahead of elections in West Bengal and Tamil Nadu.

recent_articles.title: Chaturvedi’s grumbling over defeat of Women’s Bill’ flies in the face of her party’s stand - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Shiv Sena UBT** leader Priyanka Chaturvedi criticized the defeat of the Women’s Reservation Bill in the Lok Sabha, expressing her opposition to its inclusion with the Delimitation Bill. **Sanjay Raut**, a Shiv Sena UBT MP, stated that the party opposed the bill because it was presented as a means for the BJP to advance their own agenda. Maharashtra Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis condemned the opposition's actions, calling them hypocritical and stating that they prioritized politics over progress.

recent_articles.title: INDIA bloc opposes Delimitation Bill - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Mallikarjun Kharge**, president of the **All India Congress Committee (AICC)**, announced that the INDIA bloc has unanimously decided to oppose the Delimitation Bill.  **Kharge** stated that opposition parties are not against the Women’s Reservation Bill but are concerned about the bill's linking with delimitation and seat increases in State Assemblies. Several Opposition leaders, including **T.R. Baalu**, **Tejashwi Yadav**, and **Sanjay Raut**, expressed their opposition to the Delimitation Bill.

recent_articles.title: Discontinue Ladki Bahin if government doesn’t have funds for pension: Bombay HC - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Bombay High Court** criticized the Maharashtra government for its financial mismanagement, stating that the **Mahayuti government's** flagship scheme, the **Ladki Bahin Yojana**, should be discontinued if it cannot afford to pay pensions to retired employees. The court questioned the government's priorities and demanded an explanation for the non-payment of pension dues by the **Additional Commissioner**.  The court also urged the government to consider selling assets like tables, chairs, and cars to fund employee pensions.

recent_articles.title: Why did the Congress withdraw its candidate from Baramati at the last minute? - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **NCP** and **NCP(SP)** leaders, including Sunetra Pawar, met with **Maharashtra Congress** president Harshawardhan Sapkal to request the withdrawal of their candidate from the Baramati by-election.  The Pawars argued for a united front against a competing candidate, while **Congress** leaders expressed disappointment over the lack of outreach from the **NCP**. The **Congress** eventually backed down and agreed to withdraw its candidate in response to pressure from allies and the **Pawar family**.

recent_articles.title: Battle for Baramati: Sunetra Pawar files nomination, Sharad Pawar’s photo displayed during NCP rally - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Sunetra Pawar**, daughter of **Sharad Pawar**, filed her nomination as the Nationalist Congress Party candidate for the upcoming Baramati by-election.  She was accompanied by Deputy Chief Minister **Eknath Shinde** and BJP cabinet minister **Chandrashekhar Bawankule**. **Sharad Pawar** expressed disapproval of his photo being displayed alongside **Narendra Modi** and **Amit Shah**, stating that it was wrong to do so. While senior NCP leaders, **Praful Patel** and **Sunil Tatkare**, suggested speaking with the Congress leadership for an unopposed election, Sunetra Pawar's son, **Parth**, indicated he would not engage in such negotiations.  **Sanjay Raut** of Shiv Sena UBT expressed that it was acceptable to field a candidate in elections.

recent_articles.title: MVA rift: Uddhav likely to back Sunetra Pawar in Baramati bypoll, but Congress not on board - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The Congress** broke with its MVA partners, declaring it would contest the upcoming Baramati Assembly by-election.  **Sunetra Pawar**, widow of deceased NCP leader **Ajit Pawar**, is the ruling alliance's candidate. **Shiv Sena (UBT)** chief **Uddhav Thackeray** is expected to announce his party's decision soon, with sources indicating a likely support for **Sunetra Pawar**.  The Congress, however, has decided to contest the by-election independently, citing a lack of communication and participation in alliance discussions.

recent_articles.title: Sunetra Pawar to file nomination on April 6, contest won’t be unopposed in Baramati - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Sunetra Pawar**, the Deputy Chief Minister of Maharashtra, will file her nomination for the Baramati by-election on April 6th. The seat fell vacant after the death of her husband **Ajit Pawar** in an air crash earlier this year.  The election is expected to test the unity of the opposition Maha Vikas Aghadi alliance as allies may compete against each other. While the Nationalist Congress Party (NCP) has declared it will not field a candidate against Sunetra Pawar, the Maharashtra Congress and Shiv Sena UBT have expressed their intention to support a candidate in Baramati.

recent_articles.title: ‘On Kharat’s call list, DCM Eknath Shinde, Minister Shirsat, Uddhav’s close aide Milind Narvekar’ - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Anjali Damania**, a social activist, claims that **Eknath Shinde**, **Sanjay Shirsat**, **Milind Narvekar**, and other prominent politicians were on the call list of arrested godman **Ashok Kharat**.  Damania based her claim on a CDR she possesses, stating that there were 17 calls between **Shinde** and **Kharat**, with one call lasting for 21 minutes. **Rupali Chakankar**, an NCP leader, had the most frequent conversations with **Kharat**, followed by his sister and other high-profile individuals like **Sunil Tatkare**, **Chandrakant Patil**, and **Ashish Shelar**.

recent_articles.title: Pednekar Withdraws Proposal to Include Manache Shlok in BMC Schools After MIM Opposition - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Kishori Pednekar**, a leader of the Uddhav Thackeray-led Shiv Sena faction, withdrew a proposal to make the Manache Shlok, a composition by Samarth Ramdas Swami, part of the curriculum in schools run by the **Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation** after **AIMIM** raised objections.  **Vijay Ubale**, the AIMIM group leader, argued that schools should not mandate teachings from any one religion and instead focus on constitutional values and fundamental duties. Pednekar expressed regret for her previous remarks connecting the text to Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar and clarified that she did not intend to imply the Manache Shlok belonged solely to Hindus.

recent_articles.title: Shiv Sena (UBT) open to alliance with MNS for Maharashtra’s benefit, says Sanjay Raut - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Sharad Pawar**, NCP (SP) chief, and six other candidates from the **Mahayuti alliance** filed nominations for seven Rajya Sabha seats in Maharashtra.  The ruling coalition's nominees are expected to be elected unopposed due to a lack of opposition. **Sanjay Raut**, Shiv Sena (UBT) leader, stated his party is willing to make concessions for the benefit of Maharashtra and its Marathi-speaking population.
